انحدرن (form VII)
# اِنْحَدَرْنَ (inḥadarna) /in.ħa.dar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# اِنْحَدِرْنَ (inḥadirna) /in.ħa.dir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
